QuestInfo.name: Stumpy the Ent
QuestInfo.1: All of Perion is dried out because #o3220000# is sucking nourishment from the land of #m102000000#. If nothing is done, #m102000000# is doomed! Winston asked you to eliminate #r#o3220000##k.
QuestInfo.2: As Dr. #p1022006# requested, you eliminated #o3220000#, and saved #m102000000# from devastation.

0.0: After examining the #t4031773#es, I have concluded that Stumpy is causing the drought in Perion.
0.1: #o3220000# was once the guardian spirit of Perion, who took the form of a beautiful tree. Something corrupted it, and it became a terrible monster. What we didn't realize is that #o3220000# started draining the life force from the land of #m102000000#. That's why the Stumps are drying out.
0.2: This is nothing short of a disaster. If this continues, #m102000000# will become a barren wasteland. I need your help again, and I need it now.

yes.0: #o3220000# is a very dangerous monster. It has drained much life from the land, and grown strong. The only way to save #m102000000# is to rid it of #r#o3220000#. Please, eliminate #o3220000#.

no.0: You don't get it, do you? This threatens all of us, including yourself! Don't be foolish.

1.0: I say, you're back! I could feel a shift in the energy of the land... You defeated Stumpy, didn't you? Ha HA! You've saved the land, my friend!

mob.0: Stumpy appears in #m102020500# from time to time. You must destroy it before it consumes more energy...
